text: This report responds to the Board of Health's request for an update on the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on school-age children and youth, including current programs operated by Toronto Public Health (TPH) to support this population (see Item HL35.7). The COVID-19 pandemic has had both direct and indirect impacts on the health of children and youth. Data on COVID-19 cases and outcomes over the course of the pandemic show that children and youth have generally experienced less severe outcomes from COVID-19 infection, relative to older age groups. Although rare, instances of serious illness and loss of life have occurred among children and youth. These are tragic outcomes for those who have been impacted, as well as their family, friends, and communities.
